WITH successful_payment AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.order_id)
        p.order_id,
        p.payment_method
    FROM payments AS p
    WHERE p.status = 'successful'
    ORDER BY
        p.order_id,
        p.payment_id DESC
)
SELECT
    sp.payment_method,
    c.category_id,
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
        - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount, 0)
    ) AS revenue
FROM orders AS o
JOIN successful_payment AS sp
    ON sp.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories AS c
    ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
    sp.payment_method,
    c.category_id,
    c.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, sp.payment_method, c.category_id;
